description: Colombo Municipal Council - Order to name a road as Sri Vachissra Mahimi Mawatha in Colombo
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with the naming of a specific road ("Sri Wachissara Nahimi Mawatha") by a local government authority (Colombo Municipal Council). The notification provides details about the road's location, description, and the legal authority under which it was named. This falls under land and property-related matters, specifically concerning municipal infrastructure and street naming, which is classified as a Land Gazette (Type 4). While government officials are mentioned, the primary focus is on the land/property matter, not on government personnel changes or structural reorganization.
